paragraphs.text:
Your party hurries from the megalithic wheel and hastens back 
to the riverside.

If you have the keyword BAREFOOT, go to 458 if your party still 
has five members, or 424 if you have lost someone. If you do not have 
that keyword, go to 20 if your party still has five members, or 163 if 
you have lost someone.
